auth.md — luiskr.com

Authentication and registration guidance for AI agents and automated clients.

Audience

Agents, crawlers, and other automated systems consuming content from https://luiskr.com.

Authentication

No authentication or registration is required. All public content is readable over HTTPS without credentials:

  • Pages and the docs portal: /, /docs
  • Machine-readable content: /docs-content/** (JSON), /llms.txt, /ai-catalog.json
  • Discovery metadata: /.well-known/api-catalog, /openapi.json, /sitemap.xml

Registration

There is no agent registration or provisioning endpoint. For access beyond the public endpoints, contact luis.krotz@gmail.com.

Credentials

Not applicable — this site issues and accepts no credentials for public content. Do not send Authorization headers or API keys; they are ignored.

Usage preferences

Content-usage preferences are declared via Content-Signal in /robots.txt (ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=no). Link response headers advertise the machine-readable resources above (RFC 8288 / RFC 9727).
